title: 第21章 吞噬妖丹第22章 银角三尾蛇
lines: 那妖丹似乎感觉到了威胁，红黑二色的妖力从那妖丹之中冲出，凝聚成赤环瞳蛇的模样。
它对着黑龙张开脖颈，不断吐蛇信。
是在示威！
黑龙双眼深沉而凶戾，它咆哮一声，直接将那赤环瞳蛇的虚影粉碎，旋即俯身向下，一口将妖丹吞噬了下去。
林辰心头一动。
他此刻乃是天钨的主人，而天钨由九天斩神诀所化，与林辰是完全相连的。
几乎瞬间林辰就感觉到了那妖丹化作精纯的力量，已经被天钨彻底吸收。
而天钨的虚形，也较之前多了几分凝实之感！
吞噬妖丹能够令天钨变强？！
林辰眸光顿时闪动不息。
这对他来说，毫无疑问是绝好的消息！
“但不知是不是只有蛇类或者蛟龙之属的妖丹，才能够被吞噬”
，林辰很快收敛心绪，低语道。
蛇类其实与龙是有着关联的，算是沾亲带故，蛇类不断进化，获取力量，其中佼佼者将蜕变成为蛟龙！
而强横的蛟龙血脉进一步的增强，则有机会化身为龙！
所以它们虽不同族，但算是同一个属，有着关联。
这或许就是赤环瞳蛇的妖丹能够被吞噬的原因所在。
如此。
林辰找了个隐蔽角落，先隐藏起来，然后从空间戒指中取出各类妖丹。
不论是从山寨洗劫来的，还是九鼎商会的货，妖丹都不在少数。
正好可以试验一番。
“三阶妖兽，三眼狂蟒的妖丹”
，林辰取出一枚漆黑的妖丹。
然后他运转九天斩神诀，天钨浮现在手。
而随着林辰心念转动，天钨迅速化作黑龙，一口将三眼狂蟒的妖丹吞下。
很清楚的可以感觉到妖丹化作精纯力量，被天钨吸收。
而天钨再度强大了一分！
“那么烈焰火鸟的妖丹呢？”
林辰眸光闪动。
将一枚火红的妖丹取出。
天钨化作的黑龙缓缓在空中盘旋着，但似乎没有什么兴趣，看来的确是需要同属的妖丹才行。
不过林辰不打算就此放弃，当下以自身之意志催动天钨吞噬妖丹。
黑龙有些不情愿，不过它无法违逆作为剑主的林辰，还是俯身向下，一口将烈焰火鸟的妖丹吞了下去。
妖丹的力量很快就被黑龙消化分解，化作了最为精纯的能量，但却并未被黑龙吸收，这并不是它所需的。
“果然不行吗？”
林辰皱了皱眉，如果只能是蛟龙之属、蛇族等，那么范围就太小了。
会影响效率。
当然，如果的确是这样的规则，林辰也无可奈何，只能想办法去找可用的妖丹！
“黑龙无法吸收，那我呢？”
林辰见黑龙的确不打算吸收这精纯力量，念头突然一动。
或许，能够为他所用！
当下林辰控制黑龙，将那精纯力量释放出来。
而那股力量，直接出现在了林辰的丹田之中，随着九天斩神诀的运转，渗透向林辰的四肢百骸！
他吸收了这股力量！
content_en:
The demon pill seemed to feel threatened, and the red and black demon power rushed out of the demon pill, condensing into the shape of a red-ringed snake.
It opened its neck towards the black dragon and kept spitting out snake messages.
It's a demonstration!
The black dragon's eyes were deep and fierce. It roared and shattered the shadow of the red-ringed snake. Then it leaned down and swallowed the demon pill in one gulp.
Lin Chen's heart moved.
He was the master of Tiantungsten at the moment, and Tiantungsten was transformed from the Nine Heavens Killing God Technique and was completely connected to Lin Chen.
Almost instantly, Lin Chen felt that the pure power of the demon pill had been completely absorbed by Tiantungsten.
And the virtual shape of Tiantungsten is a little more solid than before!
Can swallowing demon pills make Tiantungsten stronger? !
Lin Chen's eyes suddenly flashed.
This is undoubtedly excellent news for him!
"But I don't know if only snakes or dragon-like demon pills can be swallowed."
, Lin Chen quickly calmed down and whispered.
Snakes are actually related to dragons. They are closely related. Snakes continue to evolve and gain strength, and the best among them will transform into dragons!
And if the powerful dragon bloodline is further strengthened, there is a chance to transform into a dragon!
Therefore, although they are of different races, they are considered to be of the same genus and are related.
This may be the reason why the red-ringed pupil snake's demon elixir can be swallowed.
in this way.
Lin Chen found a hidden corner, hid first, and then took out various demon pills from the space ring.
Whether they were looted from the cottage or goods from the Jiuding Chamber of Commerce, there were many demon pills.
Just in time to experiment.
"Third-level monster, the demon pill of the three-eyed python"
, Lin Chen took out a dark demon pill.
Then he performed the Nine Heavens Killing God Technique, and Tiantungsten appeared in his hand.
As Lin Chen's thoughts turned, Tiantungsten quickly transformed into a black dragon and swallowed the three-eyed python's demon elixir in one gulp.
You can clearly feel the demon pill turning into pure power and being absorbed by Tiantungsten.
And Tiantungsten is stronger again!
"What about the Fiery Bird's demon elixir?"
Lin Chen's eyes flashed.
Take out a fiery red demon pill.
The black dragon transformed from Tiantungsten was slowly hovering in the air, but it seemed to have no interest. It seemed that it really needed the same demon pill.
However, Lin Chen did not intend to give up, and immediately used his own will to urge Tiantungsten to swallow the demon pill.
The black dragon was a little reluctant, but it couldn't disobey Lin Chen as the sword master, so it still leaned down and swallowed the flaming bird's demon elixir in one gulp.
The power of the demon pill was quickly digested and decomposed by the black dragon and turned into the purest energy, but it was not absorbed by the black dragon, which was not what it needed.
"Isn't it true?"
Lin Chen frowned. If it could only be the dragon clan, snake clan, etc., then the scope would be too small.
Will affect efficiency.
Of course, if this is indeed the rule, Lin Chen has no choice but to find ways to find available demon pills!
"The black dragon can't absorb it, what about me?"
When Lin Chen saw that the black dragon really did not intend to absorb this pure power, his thoughts suddenly came to him.
Maybe it can be used by him!
At this moment, Lin Chen controlled the black dragon and released the pure power.
And that power appeared directly in Lin Chen's Dantian, and with the operation of the Nine Heavens Killing God Art, it penetrated into Lin Chen's limbs and bones!
He absorbed this power!
title_en: Chapter 21 Swallowing the Demonic Pill Chapter 22 Silver-Horned Three-tailed Snake
